classification_method.fine_grained_enough: No source_preserving_planunit remains and live PlanUnit YAML parses without errors.
classification_method.layout_normalization_needed: Source-preserving bridge doc with enough headings/spans or ambiguity to need layout/section normalization before broad atomization.
classification_method.owner_consumer_unclear: Source-preserving bridge doc whose pre-PlanUnits body has known cross-owner role, contractref_count >= 30, or >=120 owner/stale/compatibility/conflict term hits. This is a routing-risk flag, not a final owner decision.
classification_method.source_preserving_bridge_only: At least one live PlanUnit uses node_compile_hint.mode=source_preserving_planunit.
classification_method.too_large_for_one_batch: line_count > 400 or span_count > 40, requiring bounded doc windows or multiple batches.
